verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents bring-your-own model backends: you pick from many LLM providers, authenticate, and set the default model. Community reports also describe subscription use through `claude -p`, though users say Anthropic later cut subscription access and Google restricted subscribers. Nothing in the evidence shows token usage or cost reporting per model or per conversation, which is half the story. Missing for 10: token usage visibility, cost tracking per model or conversation, documented and stable subscription support.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, I bring my own API keys or subscriptions and can see token usage and cost per model or per conversation

citations.quote: OpenClaw can use many LLM providers. Pick a provider, authenticate, then set the default model as `provider/model`.
OpenClaw used Claude Code as the harness via `claude -p` (the docs' 'Claude CLI as the message provider' option)
